feature_summary.description: Admin-only tool with two modes for controlled production-grade candidate data seeding

Mode B (CV/ZIP): Upload ZIP containing resumes → Parse CVs with AI → Create profiles with cv_attached=true
Smart Deduplication: Higher salary wins, skills merge, job history merge
Strict Governance: All imports Admin-only until discovered via AI Screening
